title: Three Years and One Short Charter
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：liberty　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 liberty 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1948 the judge ① defended the liberty that no citizen in the court would have recorded, and he said the defending was the whole of the year. The ② liberty, meaning the freedom itself and not the charter, ran three years and stayed unrecorded in the book; liberty, he said, is the only thing in a court that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of liberty in that court had the same short charter beside it, and the ④ liberty at the far door, meaning the right they kept for the children to claim and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Liberty, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the judge said the recording is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the liberty was the whole of the matter, meaning the duty and not the freedom. The ⑥ liberty, meaning the duty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; liberty, he said, is either something you defend or the only word that means both freedom and a duty. He said the duty is the part they remember.

By 1953 the ⑦ liberty had become a line in a statute, and the statute had become an argument about the short charter. The ⑧ liberty of the whole thing, the judge wrote in October, was one court and three years of recording; liberty, he said, is either the right at the far door or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ liberty I remember is the liberty recorded in the statute, which closed in 1955 and is still recorded as the quietest in the court. ⑩ Liberty, my mother said in 1957, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all liberty, she said, is a duty that has agreed to look like freedom. She said the duty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 自由；自由权（指法庭里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 自由；自由权（指那种自由本身，与宪章相对）
C. 固定搭配：defend the liberty 捍卫这种自由
D. n. 自由；自由权（指留给孩子们主张的那一项权利那一种）
E. n. 法度之事（抽象总称，指一处法庭的自由之事）
F. n. 自由；自由权（指法令里写到、被记载的的那一种）
G. n. 义务、本分（指一件事里人人都讲却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 本分（抽象总称，指人人都讲却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: defended the liberty that no citizen in the court would have recorded
The liberty, meaning the freedom itself and not the charter
Every kind of liberty in that court
the liberty at the far door
the liberty was the whole of the matter
the liberty had become a line in a statute
The liberty of the whole thing

answers.why: defend the liberty 意为“捍卫这种自由”，1948 年那位法官把法庭里没有一位公民肯记载的一种自由做了一遍。
liberty 意为“自由；自由权”，指那种自由本身而不是宪章，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被记载。
liberty 意为“自由；自由权”，指法庭里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一份薄薄的宪章。
liberty 意为“自由；自由权”，指最远那扇门口留给孩子们主张的那一项权利那一种，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
liberty 意为“义务、本分”，指一件事里人人都讲却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项义务就是那件事的全部。
liberty 意为“本分”，指人人都讲却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种自由，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
liberty 意为“自由；自由权”，指法令里写到、被记载的的那一种，到 1953 年这一种成了法令里的一行。
liberty 意为“法度之事”，法官十月写道，整件事的自由之事是一处法庭和三个年头的记载。
liberty 意为“自由；自由权”，我记得的是法令里记载过的那一种，1955 年写明了，至今仍被说成法庭里最安静的一种。
liberty 为抽象总称，母亲 1957 年说，自由是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的自由。
